mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears mount.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline exceeding 1% in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based consumer demand slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 1% and RSAFS decline > 1% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 102.0 (indicating strong manufacturing and industrial activity) supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by signaling sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2% indicates a contraction in the housing market that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 2% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 2% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls exceeding 200k and an unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.2 percentage points in the same month indicates a labor market deterioration due to rising labor force participation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 200k and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400, it signals a high-inflation, weak-demand environment that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300 and HOUST < 1400.
